title: 第19章 最不像凡人的凡人第20章 你不讨厌她吗
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
江欲虽然有五个道侣可是最近她出入的时候发现府邸很冷清，除了经常出门的沧溟和养伤的元梵，她一个其他的人都没有见到。
“系统你给我介绍一下剩下的几个人。”
在路上的江欲开口。
但是平常一直话痨的系统这次却没有立马说话，而是罕见的有些沉默。
江欲当然知道它这是在心虚什么：“你要是解释好了，我就不计较你之前骗我说是五个全新未拆封的美男，而且除了他们这个世界还有很多美男的事情了。”
【宿主，你果然是我见过最温柔大方美丽动人的……】
“说正事。”
江欲毫不犹豫打断系统。
【哦好，剩下的三个人一个叫谢云开，曾经是御兽宗的少宗主，因为被诬陷偷了宗门法宝被废了一身修为赶出来了，本命灵兽不知所踪，灵根碎裂。
另一个叫陆川，是狼兽人，原本是妖族少主，被继母和弟弟换了妖骨，失去了妖族众人的民心。】
“都是这么惨吗？”
江欲有些奇怪地挠了挠自己的头发，声音里都是不理解：“原本你的主人不是要找一些帮手吗，怎么听着这些道侣不是残疾就是被各种陷害。”
“这真的能帮上什么忙吗？”
【宿主你真是问到点上了。】
像是想到什么，系统的声音带上了几分可怜。
【这些人大部分契约的时候其实都是天之骄子级别的，就算是身体有些不好的元梵都有预知未来的能力。】
【本来道侣之间契约就是为了互相促进成长，可是他们在和原主契约之后都开始慢慢地变得不顺利起来，最后各个都出了事，好像被夺走了气运一样。】
再加上原宿主一直压榨大家，又无暇管他们的死活，所以他们两个就慢慢不回来了。】
江欲恍然大悟的点点头，要是系统不说她还以为这个原主是个傻子，契约这么多没用的人。
原来这些人是接近了江欲才会慢慢变倒霉的。

“被夺走了气运……”
江欲说着，脑海里不由自主地浮现出了白婉婉可怜巴巴的脸。
原主自己的经历和这几个道侣似乎也差不多，从前的江欲作为宗门里的大师姐，也是天之骄子的存在。
可是白婉婉出现之后，不仅被绑上了舍己为人系统，修炼天赋也消失了，甚至人都变得又丑又胖的。
“白婉婉果然有问题。”
江欲这么想着，又开口问道：“那最后一个呢。”
系统显然是对最后一个人态度有些不一样，沉默了一下才有些犹豫地开口。
【宿主，你的最后一个道侣我也不知道该怎么介绍。】
【他叫江寻竹，是个人类。】
江欲等了半天都没有等到下文：“就没了？”
【是的宿主，没了。】
【这个人就是一个普普通通的人类，每天在宗门里泡泡茶做做饭，也不见他有什么其他的事情做，连修炼都不能修炼。】
【他也不是我给前宿主找的道侣，是在要和其他人契约的时候闯进来不小心契约的，因为没有任何身份只是一个人类，被前宿主扔在院里不管了。】
“这也能契约错吗？”
content_en:
Although Jiang Yu has five Taoist companions, when she went in and out recently, she found that the mansion was deserted. Except for Cang Ming who often went out and Yuan Fan who was recovering from his injuries, she didn't see anyone else.
"System, please introduce me to the remaining people."
On the road, Jiang wanted to speak.
However, the usually talkative system did not speak immediately this time, but was unusually silent.
Of course Jiang Yu knew why it was guilty: "If you explain it well, I won't care about the fact that you lied to me before and said it was five brand new and unopened beauties, and besides them, there are many beauties in this world."
[Host, you are indeed the most gentle, generous, beautiful and touching person I have ever seen...]
"Let's get down to business."
Jiang Yu interrupted the system without hesitation.
[Oh, okay, one of the remaining three people is named Xie Yunkai. He was once the young master of the Beast Control Sect. He was framed for stealing the sect's magic weapon and was driven out with his cultivation broken. His native spirit beast disappeared and his spiritual roots were shattered.
The other one is Lu Chuan, a wolf orc who was originally the young master of the demon clan. His stepmother and brother exchanged his demon bones for him, and he lost the hearts of everyone in the demon clan. 】
"Are they all this miserable?"
Jiang Yu scratched his hair strangely, his voice full of confusion: "Didn't your master originally want to find some helpers? It sounds like these Taoist monks are either disabled or framed in various ways."
"Is this really going to help?"
[Host, you really hit the mark with your question. 】
As if thinking of something, the system's voice sounded a little pitiful.
[Most of these people were actually at the level of the Proud Ones when they signed the contract. Even Yuan Fan, who was in some bad health, had the ability to predict the future. 】
[Originally, the contract between Taoist couples was to promote each other's growth, but after they made the contract with the original owner, things gradually became unsatisfactory. In the end, something happened to each of them, as if their luck was taken away. 】
In addition, the original host kept squeezing everyone and had no time to care about their life and death, so the two of them gradually stopped coming back. 】
Jiang Yu nodded with sudden realization. If the system hadn't told him, she would have thought that the original owner was a fool for contracting so many useless people.
It turns out that these people gradually become unlucky only when they get close to Jiang Yu.
"My luck was taken away..."
As Jiang Yu spoke, Bai Wanwan's pitiful face appeared in his mind involuntarily.
The original owner's own experience seems to be similar to that of these Taoist monks. In the past, Jiang Yu, as the senior sister in the sect, was also a proud person of heaven.
But after Bai Wanwan appeared, not only was she tied into the system of self-sacrifice, her cultivation talent also disappeared, and she even became ugly and fat.
"Bai Wanwan really has a problem."
Jiang Yu thought this and asked again: "What about the last one?"
The system obviously had a different attitude toward the last person. It was silent for a while before speaking hesitantly.
[Host, I don’t know how to introduce your last Taoist companion. 】
[His name is Jiang Xunzhu, and he is a human being. 】
Jiang Yu waited for a long time without waiting for the next sentence: "It's gone?"
[Yes, the host is gone. 】
[This person is just an ordinary human being. He makes tea and cooks in the sect every day. He doesn’t have anything else to do. He can’t even practice. 】
[He is not the Taoist companion I found for my former host. He broke in when he was about to make a contract with someone else and accidentally made a contract. Because he has no identity, he is just a human being and was left in the courtyard by the former host. 】
"Can this also be a contract mistake?"
